title: Double-Eye Connecting Rod Display

This fills the connecting-rod visual branch of the original piston theme. The two holes are empty, with no pins or moving mating parts. One fixed stylised display only: no rotation, stroke, force transmission, working bearing, mechanical fit, load, manufacture, installation, engineering precision, structural stability or safety certification. No cylinder, crankshaft, flywheel, animation, texture, text or surrounding scene.
